Level 9 Bastion Facility

Prerequisite: None
Space: Cramped
Hirelings: 1
Order: Trade

A small salon, closet, or antechamber where you keep and catalog peculiar objects and fascinating oddities.

Trade: Acquire Curios. You give the hireling gold to buy strange items from unusual sources. They return after 28 days with one or more magic items. Your investment sets their rarity, and the number of Haunted special facilities in your Bastion when the hireling returns sets how many there are. The DM rolls the Cursed Item Chance: on a success, one of the items (DM's choice) carries a curse the DM defines. Determine each item on the Random Magic Items table of its rarity in the Dungeon Master's Guide, with a random treasure theme.
